title: Copyright Guide
description: The library provides copyright expertise and guidance to the university community. This guide helps make informed decisions regarding appropriate uses of copyrighted materials.

title: Data Management Guide
description: This guide helps researchers become familiar with data management practices, including data storage standards and protocols, metadata reporting requirements and best practices, and the requirements and recommendations of national funding bodies and professional associations.

title: Digital Collections
description: Digital Collections make tens of thousands of rare and unique items openly available online for research and learning.

title: Research Guides
description: Our Research Guides provide tailored help to get started with research and finding resources curated for U of I classes and subjects.

title: A-Z Databases
description: Library databases provide discovery and access to research materials online.

title: Library Catalog
description: Our library catalog and discovery system Primo provides one-stop searching for books, e-books, articles, and more.

title: GIS Day @ University of Idaho
description: A free event bringing together scholars, students, professionals, businesses, and the public to discuss geospatial technologies and demonstrate their many uses.

title: INSIDE Idaho
description: The geospatial data clearinghouse for Idaho assisting in the discovery and use of geospatial information.
